title: "BSC Settlement Concept Maps"
---

# _Generated by AI from user-created BSC context doc, pending SME validation_

These diagrams provide a high-level conceptual map of selected Balancing and Settlement Code concepts. They are intended to support taxonomy, glossary, ontology, and data-model discussions by separating legal participants, roles, accounts, BM Units, metering, balancing actions, settlement economics, SVA profiling, disconnection volumes, and party lifecycle concepts.

The diagrams distinguish between persistent participant entities, contextual roles, asset-side concepts, market-side concepts, process/time concepts, and supporting reference or calculated data. Solid arrows represent direct relationships from the supplied relationship list. Dashed arrows represent supporting, derived, aggregating, or explanatory relationships used to make the settlement structure readable.

## Visual conventions

| Style | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Blue rounded, solid | Actor / persistent participant entity |
| Blue rounded, dashed | Role / participation capacity |
| Amber square | Asset-side concept, including BM Units, metering systems, network points |
| Green square | Market-side concept, including accounts, prices, trades, charges |
| Purple square | Process, time period, event, or lifecycle state |
| Grey square | Reference data, calculated value, support object, or settlement property |
| Solid arrow | Direct relationship supplied in the source relation list |
| Dashed arrow | Supporting, derived, aggregating, or explanatory relationship |

## 1. Parties, roles, accounts, and liabilities

This diagram separates the legal idea of a Party from the participation capacities or roles that a Party can hold. It also shows the core link between Trading Parties, Energy Accounts, Trading Charges, and Credit Cover.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph parties["Parties, roles, accounts, and liabilities"]
        Party(["Party"]):::actor
        BSCCo(["BSCCo"]):::actor

        NETSO(["NETSO"]):::role
        TP(["Trading Party"]):::role
        Supplier(["Supplier"]):::role
        VLP(["Virtual Lead Party"]):::role
        VTP(["Virtual Trading Party"]):::role
        DSO(["Distribution System<br/>Operator"]):::role
        BSCClr(["BSC Clearer"]):::role

        PartCap["Participation<br/>Capacity"]:::support
        EA["Energy Account"]:::market
        PEA["Production Energy<br/>Account"]:::market
        CEA["Consumption Energy<br/>Account"]:::market
        VBA["Virtual Balancing<br/>Account"]:::market

        PartyDetails["Party Details"]:::support
        PartyReg["Party Registration Data"]:::support
        TradingCharge["Trading Charge"]:::market
        CreditCover["Credit Cover"]:::support
        EnergyCreditCover["Energy Credit Cover"]:::support

        BSCCo -->|is a| Party
        BSCClr -->|is a| Party
        NETSO -->|is a| Party
        TP -->|is a| Party
        Supplier -->|is a| Party
        VLP -->|is a| Party
        DSO -->|is a| Party
        VTP -->|is a| TP

        Party -->|has capacity| PartCap
        TP -->|holds| EA
        PEA -->|is a| EA
        CEA -->|is a| EA
        VLP -->|holds| VBA

        TP -->|is liable for| TradingCharge
        CreditCover -.->|secures exposure to| TradingCharge
        EnergyCreditCover -.->|energy expression of| CreditCover

        Party -.->|has| PartyDetails
        Party -.->|has| PartyReg
        PartyReg -.->|records| PartCap
    end

    classDef actor fill:#E6F1FB,stroke:#185FA5,color:#0E3D6D;

    classDef asset fill:#FCE8C3,stroke:#C58A00,color:#5B4200;
    classDef market fill:#E6F4EA,stroke:#2E8B57,color:#1F5C38;
    classDef process fill:#EFE7FF,stroke:#7E57C2,color:#4B2E83;
```

## 2. Party accession, transfer, novation, and discontinuance

This lifecycle diagram adds the concepts that sit around Party registration and ongoing participation. It is useful where the glossary needs to distinguish an entity seeking to join the BSC from one already bound by the Code, transferring obligations, or discontinuing participation.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph lifecycle["Party accession, transfer, novation, and discontinuance"]
        Person["Person / entity"]:::support
        PartyApplicant["Party Applicant"]:::process
        NovationApplicant["Novation Applicant"]:::process
        Party(["Party"]):::actor
        TransferringParty["Transferring Party"]:::process
        DiscontinuingParty["Discontinuing Party"]:::process

        Framework["Framework Agreement"]:::market
        Accession["Accession Agreement"]:::market
        PartyDetails["Party Details"]:::support
        PartyReg["Party Registration Data"]:::support
        PartCap["Participation<br/>Capacity"]:::support

        Person -.->|wishes to accede| PartyApplicant
        PartyApplicant -.->|accedes to| Framework
        Framework -.->|binds| Party
        Party -.->|has| PartyDetails
        Party -.->|has| PartyReg
        PartyReg -.->|records| PartCap

        Person -.->|wishes to be admitted by novation| NovationApplicant
        NovationApplicant -.->|becomes| Party

        Party -.->|may wish to transfer rights and obligations| TransferringParty
        TransferringParty -.->|transfers under| Accession

        Party -.->|may withdraw, be expelled, or transfer| DiscontinuingParty
        DiscontinuingParty -.->|ceases participation under| Framework
    end

    classDef actor fill:#E6F1FB,stroke:#185FA5,color:#0E3D6D;
    classDef role fill:#F2F8FF,stroke:#4A90D9,color:#0E3D6D,stroke-dasharray:5 3;
    classDef asset fill:#FCE8C3,stroke:#C58A00,color:#5B4200;
    classDef market fill:#E6F4EA,stroke:#2E8B57,color:#1F5C38;
    classDef process fill:#EFE7FF,stroke:#7E57C2,color:#4B2E83;
    classDef support fill:#F2F2F2,stroke:#8A8A8A,color:#333333;

    class Party actor
    class PartyApplicant,NovationApplicant,TransferringParty,DiscontinuingParty process
    class Framework,Accession market
    class Person,PartyDetails,PartyReg,PartCap support
```

## 5. Core settlement economics: prices, contracts, imbalance, cashflow, and credit

This diagram groups the main settlement properties that turn metered and contracted energy positions into imbalance, trading charges, cashflows, residual cashflows, and credit exposure.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph settlement_core["Core settlement economics"]
        TP(["Trading Party"]):::role
        BMU["BM Unit"]:::asset

        CreditCover["Credit Cover"]:::support
        EnergyCreditCover["Energy Credit Cover"]:::support

        BMUMV["BM Unit Metered<br/>Volume"]:::support
        BMUADV["BM Unit Allocated<br/>Demand Volume"]:::support

        ECV["Energy Contract Volume"]:::support
        ECVN["Energy Contract Volume<br/>Notification"]:::market
        MVRN["Metered Volume Reallocation<br/>Notification"]:::market

        EnergyImb["Energy Imbalance"]:::market
        EnergyIndebt["Energy Indebtedness"]:::support
        ActualEI["Actual Energy<br/>Indebtedness"]:::support
        MeteredEI["Metered Energy<br/>Indebtedness"]:::support

        SBP["System Buy Price"]:::market
        SSP["System Sell Price"]:::market
        ISBP["Indicative System<br/>Buy Price"]:::support
        ISSP["Indicative System<br/>Sell Price"]:::support
        IIP["Information Imbalance<br/>Price"]:::support
        VOLL["Value of Lost Load"]:::support

        PerBMUCF["Period BM Unit<br/>Cashflow"]:::support
        DailyPartyBMUCF["Daily Party BM Unit<br/>Cashflow"]:::support
        AcctEICF["Account Energy Imbalance<br/>Cashflow"]:::support
        DailyPartyEICF["Daily Party Energy<br/>Imbalance Cashflow"]:::support
        ResidualCF["Total System Residual<br/>Cashflow"]:::support

        MainFS["Main Funding Share"]:::support
        GenFS["General Funding Share"]:::support
        SVAProdFS["SVA Production<br/>Funding Share"]:::support

        TLM["Transmission Loss<br/>Multiplier"]:::support
        OTLA["Offtaking Transmission<br/>Losses Adjustment"]:::support

        ECVN -.->|notifies| ECV
        MVRN -.->|reallocates metered volume| ECV

        ECV -.->|contributes to| EnergyImb
        BMUMV -.->|contributes to| EnergyImb
        BMUADV -.->|contributes to| EnergyImb

        EnergyImb -.->|gives rise to| EnergyIndebt
        ActualEI -->|is a| EnergyIndebt
        MeteredEI -->|is a| EnergyIndebt

        SBP -->|applies in| SPeriod
        SSP -->|applies in| SPeriod
        ISBP -.->|indicative of| SBP
        ISSP -.->|indicative of| SSP
        IIP -.->|used for| EnergyImb
        VOLL -.->|parameter for scarcity pricing| SBP

        TP -->|is liable for| TradingCharge
        TradingCharge -->|calculated for| SPeriod
        EnergyIndebt -.->|feeds| TradingCharge
        TLM -.->|adjusts| TradingCharge
        OTLA -.->|adjusts| TradingCharge

        PerBMUCF -.->|for| BMU
        PerBMUCF -.->|aggregates to| DailyPartyBMUCF
        AcctEICF -.->|from| EnergyImb
        AcctEICF -.->|aggregates to| DailyPartyEICF

        TradingCharge -.->|results in| PerBMUCF
        TradingCharge -.->|results in| AcctEICF
        DailyPartyBMUCF -.->|feeds| ResidualCF
        DailyPartyEICF -.->|feeds| ResidualCF

        MainFS -.->|share of| ResidualCF
        GenFS -.->|share of| ResidualCF
        SVAProdFS -.->|share of| ResidualCF

        CreditCover -.->|covers exposure from| TradingCharge
        EnergyCreditCover -.->|energy expression of| CreditCover
        TP -.->|has exposure to| EnergyIndebt
    end
```

```mermaid
        SupplierPurchMatrix -.->|supports supplier-side demand calculations| SupplierDDV
        SupplierDiscMatrix -.->|supports supplier-side disconnection calculations| SupplierDDV

        SecBMUDelivered -.->|for| SecBMU
        SecBMUDemand -.->|for| SecBMU
        SecBMUDemand -.->|aggregates to| PartyAggSecBMUDemand
        TotalMSDelivered -.->|supports| SecBMUDelivered
        TotalMSDelivered -.->|supports| BMUMV
    end

    classDef actor fill:#E6F1FB,stroke:#185FA5,color:#0E3D6D;
    classDef role fill:#F2F8FF,stroke:#4A90D9,color:#0E3D6D,stroke-dasharray:5 3;

    classDef process fill:#EFE7FF,stroke:#7E57C2,color:#4B2E83;
    classDef support fill:#F2F2F2,stroke:#8A8A8A,color:#333333;

    class VLP role
    class SecBMU asset
    class BMUMV,BMUADV,BMUADDV,HHDiscNL,HHDiscL,SupplierDDV,BMUPurchMatrix,BMUDiscMatrix,SupplierPurchMatrix,SupplierDiscMatrix,SecBMUDelivered,SecBMUDemand,PartyAggSecBMUDemand,TotalMSDelivered support
```

---

## Reading notes

These diagrams are not intended to be a full formal ontology. They are a readable conceptual bridge between BSC glossary terms, settlement calculation objects, and future machine-readable modelling work. Where the relationship list provided an explicit relationship, the diagram uses a solid edge. Where the diagram introduces a dependency, grouping, aggregation, or calculation-support link for readability, the edge is dashed.

For ontology development, the next step would be to convert these concepts into stable identifiers and then separate:

- classes, such as Party, BM Unit, Metering System, Settlement Period;
- properties, such as BM Unit Metered Volume, System Buy Price, Supplier Deemed Take;
- relationships, such as registered by, assigned to, occurs within, calculated for;
- constraints, such as valid participation capacities, permitted BM Unit types, and time-granularity rules.
